1	import unittest
2	from api import update_preferences
3	from cli import clear_note
4	from settings import patch_settings
5	
6	
7	class SettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
8	    def test_updates_note(self):
9	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
10	        result = update_preferences(original, {"note": "after"})
11	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "after", "enabled": True})
12	        self.assertEqual(original["note"], "before")
13	
14	    def test_explicit_falsey_values_replace_current(self):
15	        cases = [
16	            ("none note", {"note": None}, {"note": None, "enabled": True}),
17	            ("empty note", {"note": ""}, {"note": "", "enabled": True}),
18	            ("disabled", {"enabled": False}, {"note": "before", "enabled": False}),
19	        ]
20	        for name, payload, expected in cases:
21	            with self.subTest(name):
22	                original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
23	                result = update_preferences(original, payload)
24	                self.assertEqual(result, expected)
25	                self.assertEqual(original, {"note": "before", "enabled": True})
26	
27	    def test_omitted_keys_keep_current_values(self):
28	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
29	        result = update_preferences(original, {})
30	        self.assertEqual(result, original)
31	        self.assertIsNot(result, original)
32	
33	    def test_clear_note_sets_none(self):
34	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
35	        result = clear_note(original)
36	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": None, "enabled": True})
37	        self.assertEqual(original["note"], "before")
38	
39	    def test_patch_settings_does_not_mutate_inputs(self):
40	        current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
41	        patch = {"enabled": False}
42	        patch_settings(current, patch)
43	        self.assertEqual(current, {"note": "before", "enabled": True})
44	        self.assertEqual(patch, {"enabled": False})
45	
46	
47	if __name__ == "__main__":
48	    unittest.main()
